text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computer programs can produce paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by these tools, while others feel worried. Can a machine truly be creative, or is it just copying what humans have made? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from large amounts of data and finds patterns. Perhaps the best result is when people and AI work together, using technology to support human ideas rather than replace them.
